heading: Projects
subheading: Selected work across charging systems, collaboration tools, and systems I built to understand the layers underneath frameworks.

items.title: TaskFlow
items.description: A collaborative task manager in the spirit of a small Trello or Jira. Spring Boot and Next.js on PostgreSQL, with JWT refresh-token rotation, WebSocket room scoping, role-based authorization, and server-side pagination.

items.title: KaroCharge
items.description: An EV charging platform. The Spring Boot API talks to CitrineOS, an OCPP CSMS, over OCPP 2.0.1, with Hasura GraphQL and AWS for the surrounding data and hosting.

items.title: EV-SIM
items.description: An OCPP 2.0.1 simulation platform with natural-language charger control. FastAPI on the backend, a Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind frontend, and the OpenAI API for the language layer.

items.title: Redis-lite
items.description: An in-memory cache engine with a hand-rolled Java core: a custom HashMap, doubly linked list, and min-heap for LRU and LFU eviction. Spring Boot sits at the edge. The core layer has no framework dependency.

items.title: Shrisketch
items.description: A collaborative diagramming web app in the spirit of Eraser.io. Next.js and Node.js with TypeScript, backed by PostgreSQL.

items.title: Car Racing Game
items.description: A browser racing game with Dr. Driving-style steering. FastAPI and PostgreSQL on the backend, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend.
